vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: militia-training
Version: 1.0.0-en2

The skill bundle is an informational assistant based on a historical military training manual ('Militia Military Training Manual'). It provides structured guidance on topics such as air defense, shooting techniques, and combat tactics. Analysis of SKILL.md and _meta.json reveals no technical indicators of malice, such as data exfiltration, unauthorized command execution, or persistence mechanisms. The instructions are strictly aligned with the stated educational purpose and include safety disclaimers and standard operational procedures for an AI agent.

llm.summary: The skill's declared purpose (militia/military training) matches the instructions, but the SKILL.md contains explicit, actionable guidance for weapons, grenades, landmines and even an 'assassination' section and also references missing support files — this is coherent but potentially dangerous and raises serious safety/legal concerns.

dimensions.detail: Name and description (militia/military training) align with the content: the SKILL.md provides modules on air defense, shooting, combat actions, combat service, etc. There are no unexpected binaries, env vars, or installs requested that would be incoherent with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md contains step-by-step, operational instructions (weapons handling, firing positions, hand grenade procedures, mine emplacement and clearance, and a '刺杀教练'—assassination—section). Those are explicit operational details that could meaningfully enable violent wrongdoing. The file also references many supporting documents under references/ (e.g., references/shooting.md) which are not present in the manifest, an inconsistency meaning the skill expects additional content that isn't bundled.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — minimal installation risk. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths requested — the skill does not ask for unrelated secrets or system access. This is proportionate to the claimed purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and user-invocable:true (defaults). Autonomous invocation is permitted (disable-model-invocation:false), which is normal for skills, but given the highly actionable violent instructions this increases risk if the skill is allowed to run autonomously — consider restricting autonomous invocation or applying extra runtime safety checks.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is internally coherent with its stated purpose, but it includes explicit, actionable instructions for weapons, explosives, landmines and an 'assassination' section — content that can facilitate serious illegal harm. Before installing or enabling: (1) consider legal and ethical prohibitions — many platforms and jurisdictions prohibit distributing this kind of guidance; (2) prefer to reject or remove detailed procedural content (keep only high-level, non-actionable historical/academic descriptions and safety-focused advice); (3) bundle or review the referenced 'references/' files (they are currently missing) so you know exactly what will be served; (4) if you must keep the skill, disable autonomous invocation or add strict runtime filters that block violent/illicit requests and require human approval for all outputs; (5) consult legal/compliance teams and platform policies — do not deploy publicly if the content facilitates violent wrongdoing.
